answer: A commit-reveal bond: each identity locks 70 and posts a sealed hash of its dawn plan on the mesa board. After dawn it reveals plan and key in one hour; auditors replay it, burning the bond on mismatch. A hollow commitment, hash posted but never revealed, burns 20; a second burns it. One shared plan burns every sharer. First filing 45, the k-th 45+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,541,500, locking 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 45 once.
